summary: Afya Limited filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 earnings release, not a special situation. 3Q26 revenue rose 6.1% YoY to R$985.2 million, Adjusted EBITDA rose 8.7% to R$433.8 million (44.0% margin, +100 bps), and net income rose 7.2% to R$171.0 million; basic EPS was R$1.88. Nine-month revenue was R$2,970.0 million (+6.7%), Adjusted EBITDA R$1,351.8 million (45.5% margin, -90 bps), net income R$634.0 million. Operating cash conversion was 99.5% with R$1,288.9 million cash. Full-year 2026 guidance was reaffirmed. No deal terms, board recommendation or advisor disclosed; watch organic growth and margin trajectory.
